statusDefinitions.covered: The Wiki has a dedicated, usable reference layer for this domain.
statusDefinitions.covered-verify: The domain is documented, but exact numbers, unlocks, prices, limits or current Server 504 UI fields remain in verification.
statusDefinitions.partial: Useful references exist, but the domain is not yet complete enough to call covered.
statusDefinitions.backlog: No dedicated reference layer yet; research should begin only when its player value justifies the maintenance cost.
